note: Only water-explicit causes are rewetting/ditch blocking (e28, e29), whose outcomes are functional-group cover, not diversity. Peatland/bog/wetland restoration nodes (e8, e10, e13, e14, e15, e31, e32) never mention water and were excluded under the strict-membership rule.

e46 counts round goby in Lake Michigan as a non-native invader (well-known, but the node does not say 'invasive'). e40 (invasive fish) has a herpetofauna outcome, not fish, so it is excluded. Candidates look thin.

Exclusion, herd-reduction and release edges were sign-flipped to the effect of browsing. Height, diameter and growth of individual seedlings were treated as growth, not stand structure, and excluded. Carp exclusion and cattle-grazing effects on grass density were excluded.
Only plant flowering/flower-stalk outcomes (e10, e11, e12), which are not breeding success under round-2 rules; soil moisture (e1, e8) is not an amendment.
No candidate has a soil or litter invertebrate outcome.

Candidates compare planting variants (position, season, container, size, site, spacing, species) or report survival of herbaceous transplants (F7DK6SC3) with no unplanted control. None compares planting with its absence on seedling or tree survival.
Excluded: neighbor control and Calamagrostis control (grass outcomes, method not stated mechanical); competing vegetation on herbaceous transplants; e16 (variant contrast); e7 (moderates).

e23/e36/e62 ('disturbance treatments including grass-specific herbicide') and e33 (cutting and glyphosate) were counted as herbicide application. Dropping them would change the answer to mixed. e19 was excluded because its sentence is about seedbank emergence, not seed heads. The mixed-treatment edges e1/e6/e47 were excluded.
No candidate measures tree species composition or dominance. Closest are deciduous seedling establishment (e4) and non-tree native density or assemblages (e2, e13, e28).

Liming edges (njaf.12-012, 706132ar) were excluded as a narrower neighbouring concept than fertilization; including them would also give increase. e2 is an NMS ordination score, so effect is null. Plant-tissue nutrient outcomes and profile similarity/variability metrics were excluded.
